bundle.shortDescription: Warframe inventory + market dashboard - see what's worth selling right now
bundle.longDescription: TennoWorth reads your Warframe inventory from the running game and ranks it against live warframe.market data, so you can see what is actually worth selling right now. Works on Windows + Linux without an account. Scanning requires the game to be running; listing on warframe.market is optional.
